sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu CI resolves .nvmrc and runs npm ci from the repository root.
Frozen .nvmrc selects the Node 24 line but deliberately does not authenticate an exact patch.
Frozen root npm lockfile is bound for the repository's npm ci preparation.
Root manifest pins npm 11.6.3 with integrity metadata and defines the workspaces consumed by the root lock.
